machine_acceptance.software: Python 3.11+, NumPy and SciPy with a 64-bit BLAS/LAPACK backend

acceptance_criteria: Load exactly L=10000, half filling, K=1, 96 central correlation modes and Delta N=-5,...,5 from this config.
Require correlation-window saturation below 1e-13 and above 1-1e-13, particle-hole residual below 5e-11, probability normalization within 1e-12, and resolved-vs-mode entropy within 1e-11.
Require the 88-to-96 active-mode convergence residual below 5e-12 for probability and 5e-11 for resolved entropy.
Require SciPy subset-eigensolver parity against an independent full NumPy eigensolve below 1e-11 on the smoke matrix.
The final CSV must be generated from formula-derived numerics; paper pixels, author arrays and author code are forbidden inputs.

machine_acceptance.accelerator: not required; 16 CPU shards may run sequentially or as a shared-filesystem job array
machine_acceptance.software: Python 3.11+, NumPy and SciPy with a 64-bit BLAS/LAPACK backend

acceptance_criteria: Load exactly 24 closest-to-zero modes, sectors Delta N=0,...,5, rank_max=1000, x_max=10, 501 analytic points and 512 quadrature nodes.
Require 16 canonical state shards to cover all 16,777,216 occupations exactly once; aggregation may retain only the exact per-sector global top-1000 weights.
Require streaming-sharded and monolithic enumeration parity below 1e-12 on an independently configured 12-mode smoke problem.
Require the all-sector analytic curve to equal I0(x) within 2e-12 and 256-to-512-node quadrature convergence below 2e-9.
Require monotonically increasing sector onsets for scientific identities 0,...,5; no run may promote the published-label discrepancy beyond inconclusive.
